metadata.description: Lintsure for Claude Code: guardrails and local security and compliance checks on the code your agent writes. An optional workspace (with an API key) tracks findings, decisions and verified fixes.

plugins.name: lintsure
plugins.description: Checks the code your agent writes against OWASP Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, CWE Top 25, GDPR, the EU AI Act and the EU CRA, and guards each edit and command. Runs locally; nothing is sent unless you add an API key.
